First in the Empress (Red Throne) storyline on Yaesha, you will need to find an Ornate Key and Ornate Lockbox in The Widow's Court location on Yaesha. The key is on a royal guard's body usually in a central location in the open. The lockbox is found behind an illusory wall next to a chest under the castle. Area can be reached by jumping down the "water" hole just before the exit to the next level, one of the paths leads to a chest next to where you can find the mentioned wall. Bring it back to Ward 13, and plant it by interacting with the hole in the ground in the garden area (across the road from Dr Norah). You will need to wait 2 days for the tree to grow before it produces fruit. Leave the fruit on the tree for it to ripen. Relic_Consumable_ConstrainedHeart: Buy from Cass at Ward 13 after performing 15 world boss kills
Relic_Consumable_CrystalHeart: Found in the Dark Conduit location on N'Erud. Find and fix the Loose Fuse at the end of the dungeon to open the door next to it, the item is inside
Relic_Consumable_DecayedHeart: Can be found in the Corrupted Harbor location on Root Earth. Past the first open area, at the end of the corridor there is a path to the right through the brambles
Relic_Consumable_DivertingHeart: Buy from Cass at Ward 13 after performing 30 world boss kills
Relic_Consumable_EnlargedHeart: Buy from Cass at Ward 13 after performing 5 world boss kills
Relic_Consumable_GossamerHeart: Found in an indoor location on N'Erud. There will be a circular area where you pick up the Crop Sample quest item, and at the side of this area there will be an elevator going down. In the room after you exit the elevator, place the Crop Sample on the blue statue. Return when you have killed a boss to get the item
Relic_Consumable_LatentHeart: Found in the Agronomy Sector location on N'Erud. Go up the ramp from the Quiescent Overlook world stone and into the blue glowing passage. Insert both Decorum Cipher and Memory Core II quest items into the fixture in front of you, which will open a screen leading you to the item. Decorum Cipher is found in the Terminus Station location on N'Erud. After you finish the train event, crawl under some hanging cables from the checkpoint and take the ladder up. Drop into the train from the hatch in its roof, Decorum Cipher will be there. Memory Core II is found in the Dormant N'Erudian Facility location on N'Erud. There will be an area with the railing, where a part of the railing will be missing. If you look down from the gap you will see the ledge you can drop on. Follow the path to the elevator and take the elevator. Soon you will reach a control room with Biome-Control Glyph quest item inside. Take it to the door at the very entrance of the location near the world stone, that can be opened with the Biome-Control Glyph. Memory Core II is behind that door · Needs Extermination AICore, Quest Item Train AICore
Relic_Consumable_LifelessHeart: Found in the Forbidden Grove location on Yaesha. First, encounter the Ravager following the story quest line, and when asked to kill the Doe, do so. It will grant you the Ravager's mark amulet. Equip it and return to the start of the Forbidden Grove location, go past Bedel of the Vaunnt and to the Ravager and the Doe statue. A trap door next to the statue will open and will grant you access to the Fruit of Death quest item. Eat it three times (you will die each time) and in the end the Fruit of Death will be consumed and you will get the item · Needs Amulet Ravagers Mark
Relic_Consumable_PaperHeart: Found in the Chamber of the Faithless location on Losomn. Find the Misplaced Memoir quest item in the Forlorn Coast location. Examine the item and interact with it to get the Bookbound Medallion quest item. Use it to open the locked door, the item is behind it
Relic_Consumable_ProfaneHeart: Obtained from the Root NPC at the end of the Infested Abyss location on Yaesha. You need to have the Profane Soul Stone amulet first. With the amulet, go to The Labyrinth and talk to The Keeper. When you end the dialog, the keeper will offer to cleanse. Refuse the offer, and you will hear the voice line to "return where we first met". Go to the very end of the Infested Abyss dungeon, talk to the Root NPC and it will exchange your Profane Soul Stone for this item
Relic_Consumable_PulsingHeart: Found in the Endaira's End location on Yaesha. From where you found Tempest Conduit ring, climb up the ladder and drop down over the low wall. There will be an illusory wall to the left of you, go through and find the item
Relic_Consumable_QuiltedHeart: Found in an overworld location on Losomn. To get this you need to complete twelve Losomn "quests" across all your rolled campaigns and adventures, you will need to reroll in order to get them all. Then you need to interact with a Dran kid in the overworld area, you might need to follow them a bit before you are able to do that. After that, climb the ladder next to Oracle's Refuge world stone and speak with the Oracle. The quests are: Postulant's Parlor, The Nightweaver (Morrow Parish), Harvester's Reach, Bloat King (The Great Sewers), Magister Dullain (Shattered Gallery), Council Chambers, Tiller's Rest, Gwentdil The Unburnt (Cotton's Kiln), Faelin/Faerin (Beatific/Malefic Gallery), The Great Hall, The Red Prince (Gilded Chambers), Butchers Quarter
Relic_Consumable_ReprocessedHeart: Found in The Labyrinth location, drop from the cycling portal when it points to another portal (goes next after the Colosseum of Ruin world stone in the cycle sequence), the other portal looks faint and far away. Get the timing right so you drop inside that other portal and you end up in a small area with the item there
Relic_Consumable_ResonatingHeart: Found in the Ashen Wasteland location on Root Earth. From the first checkpoint, instead of heading down the ramp to the carriages fight arena, go in the opposite direction to the hallway, there will be a hole in the floor nearby, drop into it, follow the path, and drop into a hole in the floor the second time, you will see the item from there
Relic_Consumable_RipenedHeart: Grown on a tree at Ward 13 location. First in the Empress (Red Throne) storyline on Yaesha, you will need to find an Ornate Key and Ornate Lockbox in The Widow's Court location on Yaesha. The key is on a royal guard's body usually in a central location in the open. The lockbox is found behind an illusory wall next to a chest under the castle. Area can be reached by jumping down the "water" hole just before the exit to the next level, one of the paths leads to a chest next to where you can find the mentioned wall. You need to inspect the lockbox, and then choose the key to open it. You will get the Thaen Seed quest item. Bring it back to Ward 13, and plant it by interacting with the hole in the ground in the garden area (across the road from Dr Norah). You will need to wait 2 days for the tree to grow before it produces fruit. Leave the fruit on the tree for it to ripen. Thaen Tree Fruit Ripening Stages: 1 Day: Mature Thaen Fruit, 2 Day: Elder Thaen Fruit, 3 Day: Celestial Thaen Fruit. The fourth time a Celestial Thaen Fruit would grow, a Ripened Heart is grown instead
Relic_Consumable_RunedHeart: Found in The Labyrinth location, from the Entangled Gauntlet world stone, go down the stairs past the statues until you hit the wall, turn to the left and follow the wall until you see the item
Relic_Consumable_SalvagedHeart: Crafted at the Drzyr Replicator in an overworld location on N'Erud. Drop into the hole in the ground on the left of the entrance of Ascension Spire where The Custodian resides, to find the Drzyr Replicator
Relic_Consumable_ShieldedHeart: Found in the Tower of the Unseen location on N'Erud. After you reach the checkpoint remove a Stellar-Powered Cell from a nearby door. Follow the path up to another door and unlock it with the Stellar-Powered Cells. Take the elevator up. Remove a Stellar-Powered Cell from a nearby door on the left and go down the elevator you came in on. Step on the elevator again but leave it before it goes up. Jump into the hole in the floor the absent elevator reveals. You will see a socket across the narrow bridge in front of you. Cross the bridge and insert the Stellar-Powered Cells, this will open a door to the elevator to your right. Jump off the bridge and take the elevator. The item will be in the room the elevator arrives at
Relic_Consumable_SiphonHeart: Found in the first overworld location on N'Erud. Given by the Custodian in exchange for the shining essence echo which is acquired by killing Tal'Ratha. You might need to talk to the Custodian before you defeat Tal'Ratha to get the item after that battle · Needs Material Shinning Essence Echo
Relic_Consumable_TormentedHeart: Feed the Nightweaver's Web the Override Pin. The quest item is found inside an unnamed tower in the Timeless Horizon location on N'Erud. The tower has an elevator that leads to a fixture that resembles the ones that have seeker's keys, but has Ionic Crystal instead. There is an inconspicuous opening you can enter on the right side of the room as you emerge from the elevator that leads to the Override Pin · Needs Core Override Pin
Relic_Consumable_TranquilHeart: Crafted by Nimue on Losomn, from the Tormented Heart relic · Needs Relic Consumable Tormented Heart
Relic_Consumable_UnsulliedHeart: Found in the Beatific Palace location on Losomn, wear the One True King Sigil amulet while standing next to the statue near the Palace Courtyard world stone · Needs Amulet One True King Sigil
Relic_Consumable_VoidHeart: Found in the Alepsis-Taura location on N'Erud. You need to defeat Sha'Hala, one of the N'Erud world bosses, without using the Override Pin quest item in the console before the fight. Talk to the Custodian after the battle and wait for 24 hours for Alepsis-Taura to unlock
Ring_PanMageSigil: Buy from Reggie after killing a Yaesha world boss in Hardcore mode
Ring_AkariWarBand: Buy from Cass at Ward 13. Random chance to be in stock
Ring_AlumniRing: Outside the Asylum after defeating the Nightweaver
Ring_AmberMoonstone: Buy from Cass at Ward 13. Random chance to be in stock
Ring_ArchersCrest: Found in an indoor location on Yaesha. There will be a square room with a waterfall in the centre. One of the room sides has an illusory wall in the middle of it, there is an (invisible) step on the other side of the illusory wall, so in order to walk in, you will have to jump. Follow the passage and you will get to the room with the item
Ring_AssassinsSeal: Found in the Council Tribunal location on Losomn. Finish the level in the Council Chamber location, interact with the mirror in the end and proceed until you arrive at the council seats. Collect the council keys from the seats and then re-insert them back in the correct order, from left to right: teal, red, purple. This will open the throne room. Climb on the ledge behind the throne and find the item on that ledge
Ring_AtonementFold: Buy from Leywise in the Forlorn Coast location on Losomn. Leywise can be found beside a cooking pot, looking extremely worried and occupied. He denies the player when he is being interacted with, until you try a few more times. After telling him, 'I want something crafted', he will explain that he does not do that because he is a Royal Scribe. After this, we can tell him that we want to buy something. Leywise will offer us the item.
Ring_BandBand: Found in an indoor location on Yaesha. There will be an area with the tower and a spiral ascent with note symbols on each level. There will also be a waterfall at the edge of the map, and an area to climb down on the waterfall side leading to a hidden room where you can find the book with the note symbols. If you and the other player stand on the symbols in order as shown in the book for the "Ship" melody you will get the item. Each time you stand on the right note a blue light will emerge from the center of the tower
Ring_BandOfAccord: Buy from Reggie at Ward 13 after performing the High Five emote in co-op
Ring_BandOfTheFanatic: Found in the Forlorn Coast location on Losomn, at the start of the level when you cross a long bridge to the main area there will be a preacher. Wear the Zealot set (otherwise you will get attacked once you approach the preacher), do not attack anyone and wait until the end of the preacher's speech. Then interact with the preacher and he will give you the item. · Needs Armor Body Ritualist, Armor Gloves Ritualist, Armor Head Ritualist, Armor Legs Ritualist
Ring_BerserkersCrest: Found in an indoor location on Yaesha. You will have to jump into a big sarcophagus from above and then tread the water behind a column
Ring_BisectedRing: Equip: Fortune Hunter skill of Explorer, Wormhole skill of Invader, Realmwalker armor set, Void Heart relic, Ford's Scattergun, Cube Gun, Labyrinth Staff, Leto's Amulet, Amber Moonstone, Black Cat Band, Anastasija's Inspiration, Zania's Malice. In the Labyrinth, head to the cycling portal. Wait until you see the scene in which you will drop into nothingness, and after two seconds enter. A bridge will appear, granting you safe passage. Move to the back of the area, you will have to fight some enemies, and turn right to find the Corrupted door. Open it using the biome portal key. Go through the gate, you'll be at "The Backrooms". Explore the backrooms until you find the item. The Fortune Hunter skill of the explorer can help find it before the timer expires · Needs Explorer, Engram Invader, Armor Body Explorer, Armor Gloves Explorer, Armor Head Explorer, Armor Legs Explorer, Relic Consumable Void Heart, Weapon Shotgun, Weapon Cube Gun, Weapon Labyrinth Staff, Amulet Letos Amulet, Ring Amber Moonstone, Ring Black Cat Band, Ring Anastasijas Inspiration, Ring Zanias Malice
Ring_BitterMemento: Feed the Memoriam Medallion Key to the Nightweaver's Web; the key is found in the Pathway of the Fallen location on Losomn. Memoriam Medallion Key drops from the Wraithliege aberration · Needs Garden Maze Mausoleum Medallion Key
Ring_BlackCatBand: Buy from Reggie at Ward 13 after dying 15 times
Ring_BlackPawnStamp: Found in an indoor location on Losomn. In the room with five torches on both sides, make all the torches blue. When you shoot or melee a torch, it and adjacent torch(es) change colour
Ring_BlackoutRing: Found in an indoor location on N'Erud. There's a locked door that you can't access, but you can see the item behind glass. Near it is a small room where you can break the objects and get into a vent under the floor. Once you get through the vent, you climb up a ladder. Before dropping down at the end, there is a small hole you can aim through and shoot an electric barrel. This powers the door and opens it for you to go through
Ring_BlastingCapRing: Found in an underground area of an overworld location on N'Erud. One of the giant pistons near the Extraction Hub world stone has a hole under it, which also registers on the minimap. You can crawl into the hole before the piston hits you, you will see the ring after you drop
Ring_BlessedRing: Buy from Cass at Ward 13. Random chance to be in stock
Ring_BloodJewel: Found in the Forbidden Grove location on Yaesha. From The Lost Temple world stone take the ladder down towards the water. There are two possible spawn points: behind the waterfall on the right, or inside the cave on the left.
Ring_BloodTingedRing: Behind a puzzle lock. Find a pattern on the first page of a book next to a skeleton, and then find 4 coffins, with shrouds matching the pattern. The symbols over those coffins are the symbols to set on the puzzle lock, they can be entered in any order. They are not pre-set and generated randomly.
Ring_BloodlessKingsVow: Drops from The Bloodless Heir aberration in the Goddess's Rest location on Yaesha. You need to activate 5 pillars with blue rings for the temple door to open. Once inside, interact with a golden bowl and do not put anything in it to summon the aberration
Ring_BraidedThorns: Buy from Cass at Ward 13. Random chance to be in stock
Ring_BreachAccelerator: Found in Agronomy Sector location on N'Erud. At the beginning after talking to the gardener and unlocking the gliders, take the first glider over the short gap and then the second glider down the canyon with the wind plume at the end. Hit the wind plume and land on the platform nearby. Head through the opening on your right and find the item
Ring_BridgeWardensCrest: Found in the Forlorn Coast location on Losomn. After getting to the Drowned Wen worldstone you reach a small checkpoint near an iron door leading to the level start. From there you need to cross the water by jumping from boat to boat. Once on the other side you need to reach the Mournful Promenade world stone without killing any Fae. If you avoid the area where Fae are fighting with Dran nearby you should not meet any additional Fae on your way to the worldstone. You will see the big Warden not far from the Worldstone. Do not attack him, talk to him and he will give you the item.
Ring_BurdenOfTheAudacious: Buy from Cass at Ward 13. Random chance to be in stock
Ring_BurdenOfTheDeparted: Found in the Chamber of the Faithless location on Losomn. Defeat The One True King while having Burden of the Divine equipped · Needs Ring Burden Of The Divine
Ring_BurdenOfTheDestroyer: Buy from Cass at Ward 13. Random chance to be in stock
Ring_BurdenOfTheDivine: Found in a sewer location on Losomn, you will come across a secret passage blocked by some destructable shelves and pots, which will lead to a room with platforms. Proceed along the path jumping across as required. The item will be on the other side of the room
Ring_BurdenOfTheExcavator: Found in Logistics Bridge location on N'Erud. Located at the very end of the dungeon in the room with the final checkpoint
Ring_BurdenOfTheFollower: Found in an indoor location on Yaesha. There is a hidden drop behind some pots in a corner to the left of a statue in a niche
Ring_BurdenOfTheGambler: Buy from Cass at Ward 13. Random chance to be in stock
Ring_BurdenOfTheMariner: Crafted at the Drzyr Replicator in an overworld location on N'Erud. Drop into the hole in the ground on the left of the entrance of Ascension Spire where The Custodian resides, to find the Drzyr Replicator
Ring_BurdenOfTheMason: Found in the Luminous Vale location on Yaesha. There are two elevators in Luminous Vale, you can see them on a fully explored map as shaded squares. You need the one that is NOT near the Primal Hollow world stone. While riding the elevator, there is a hole in the wall that leads to the room with the item
Ring_BurdenOfTheMesmer: Buy from Walt in the Ancient Canopy or Luminous Vale location on Yaesha. Walt stands near different murals in these two areas depending on your quest progression. The item price is greatly reduced if you exhaust all dialogs with Walt before finally dealing with Lydusa. Return to Walt after that to purchase the item at a reasonable price
Ring_BurdenOfTheProtector: Found in an indoor location on N'Erud. There will be an area with a console next to a window overlooking the area below. Interacting with the console unlocks the door to the elevator down to that area. The challenge is to navigate the "maze" across this area to the door at the other side, without triggering an alarm. There will be another door nearby that leads to the item. If the event fails and the alarm sounds that door will seal making the item inaccessible without re-rolling the campaign or adventure you are currently in
Ring_BurdenOfTheRebel: Rewarded by the Eternal Empress in the Red Throne location on Yaesha, after you return the Thaen Seed quest item to her that you can obtain by inspecting the Ornate Lockbox and opening it with the Ornate Key. Ornate Lockbox is found in the Widow's Court location on Yaesha behind an illusory wall next to a chest under the castle in Widow's Court, indicated by a lit brazier. The area can be reached by jumping down the "water" hole just before the exit to the next level, one of the paths leads to a chest next to where you can find the mentioned wall. Ornate Key is found in the Widow's Court on a body of a royal guard lying in the open in the general vicinity of the location exit
Ring_BurdenOfTheSciolist: Found in the Forlorn Coast location on Losomn, find the Misplaced Memoir quest item in the Forlorn Coast location on Losomn, interact with it to get the Bookbound Medallion quest item. Talk to Leywise in the Forlorn Coast location on Losomn and give him the medallion the first time he asks
Ring_BurdenOfTheStargazer: Found in a tower location on N'Erud. When going along the bridges, look for another bridge below you to drop down to. Jump there and follow the path to find the item
Ring_BurdenOfTheWarlock: Found in an outdoor location on Losomn. It is located in a graveyard that is only accessible via a burning building. You get on the top floor of the building first, and you can drop or climb down the ladder to the ground floor, but the path to the graveyard is from the middle floor where you cannot get to from the ladder. You will need to go upstairs from the ground floor first to the middle floor, and then cross over by a plank, clearing some rubble in front of it first. From there you will be able to proceed to the graveyard and get the item
Ring_BypassPrimer: Found in an indoor location on N'Erud. There will be an area with a console next to a window overlooking the area below. Interacting with the console unlocks the door to the elevator down to that area. The challenge is to navigate the "maze" across this area to the door at the other side, without triggering an alarm. The item is at the end
Ring_CaptainsInsignia: Found in the Endaira's End location on Yaesha. This is a co-op item. One person stands on the pressure plate near the checkpoint at the end of the location to open a hidden door in the wall to Pan Labyrinth. This also opens a second hidden door on the other side of the check point across a fallen column next to a visible locked door - the other person goes through that door and then opens the visible door from the inside to let the other(s) in. From there there will be a chainsaw event, where one person needs to go to the very end of the chainsaw hall and the other stands on the pressure plate near the entrance to the chainsaw hall. That will open the hidden door at the end of the hall where the item is. There are also two hidden doors on each side of the chainsaw hall operated by a pressure plate, these do not lead to the item
Ring_CatalogersJewel: Found in the Beatific Palace location on Losomn. The item is behind the locked door near the start of the location. To get the door open you need to progress further to the Malefic Palace location, complete the Jester's Card event, and unlock the door to the rest of the palace. By doing that you will unlock the corresponding door in the Beatific Palace, so you will need to return there, and enter the room behind that door. Follow the path and the item will be there
Ring_ClearHalo: Found in Athenaeum Wek location on N'Erud. Complete the encounter by inserting the House Wek Command Orb quest item into the mechanism before activating the console. The amulet can be picked up at the exit. To find the House Wek Command Orb go up with the first elevator on the right side. Stay right and stand on the only elevator that consists of a single hexagon instead of three hexagons. The single hexagon leads down to a hidden corpse with the House Wek Command Orb
Ring_CombatShieldGenerator: Found in an indoor location on N'Erud. There will be an area with cut cables glowing white-blue at the cut (as opposed to other similar cables glowing yellowish). Energize the cables with a shock weapon such as Enigma by shooting at them to open nearby doors. There are four doors in total to open, the ring is behind the second to last one
Ring_CompulsionLoop: Buy from Cass at Ward 13. Random chance to be in stock
Ring_ConjurersCircle: Found in the Infested Abyss location on Yaesha, in the area in front of the third Root Nexus. If you walk from the backtrack door, which stays on your left, towards the third Root Nexus, you will see a short deadend passage to the right on your minimap. If you face the passage where it forks from the main path, there will be a ledge to drop to on your left. Drop there, follow the short path, and find the item
Ring_ConstantVariableRing: Found in a tower location on N'Erud. There will be a circular indoor area where you can drop down to a lower level, then a sentry appears that you defeat, dropping further down, you will see the item
Ring_CrimsonDreamstone: Found in the Ethereal Manor event that spawns in an outdoor location on Losomn. Once you approach the Dran that says "Wake up" and you get teleported to the Ethereal Manor location, drink Liquid Escape. You will respawn in the Consecrated Throne area and will see the item nearby
Ring_CustodiansBastion: Found in Withered Necropolis location on N'Erud. Exhaust the Gardener's dialogue after destroying at least one of the Black Diamonds, and again after defeating the world boss
Ring_DarkSeaArmadaCrest: Found in the Proving Grounds location on Yaesha. After the fourth checkpoint, stand on the pressure plate in front of the next saw blades area that opens the way forward, once you pass the saws. Instead of going forward there, turn right into the passage that leads back to the area start should you not reach the exit before it closes. If the exit has not closed yet, another passage to the left will be open with the item in there nearby. This is much easier done when the saws are inactive, after flipping the lever after finishing the final saw blades area after the fourth checkpoint and returning to the third via the shortcut next to the lever
Ring_DeadKingsMemento: Buy from Cass at Ward 13. Random chance to be in stock
Ring_DeceiversBand: Buy from Cass at Ward 13. Random chance to be in stock
Ring_DenseSiliconRing: Found in The Labyrinth location, between the portal that leads to the Entangled Gauntlet world stone and the world stone. Up the stairs from the world stone
Ring_DevouringLoop: Buy from Reggie at Ward 13 after completing the campaign on Apocalypse difficulty
Ring_DigestedHogLure: Found in the Forlorn Coast location on Losomn. From the Drowned Wen Worldstone go straight ahead at the first intersection to the anchor statue. Kill all the pigs nearby to get the item
Ring_DisasterConverter: Found in the Agronomy Sector location on N'Erud. Fast travel back to the Devoid Quietus world stone after interacting with the gondola at the beginning of the map and trace back to the gondola location
Ring_DrakestonePearl: Found in an indoor location on Losomn. Get grabbed (and killed) by a Manticora standing close to a drain. You respawn in its lair in the sewers, the item drops when you kill the manticora
Ring_DranMemento: Found in the Butcher's Quarter location on Losomn. Do not allow the Dran to be burned during the burning event next to the checkpoint
Ring_DranScavengerSigil: Buy from Reggie after killing a Losomn world boss in Hardcore mode
Ring_DrzyrSniperSigil: Buy from Reggie after killing a N'Erud world boss in Hardcore mode
Ring_BrightSteelRing: Buy from Reggie at Ward 13 after performing 10 world boss kills
Ring_DyingEmber: Found in the Ashen Wasteland location on Root Earth. From the second checkpoint follow the main path down into the sewers, until you get into the water. There will be an opening on the left of you that leads to a maintenance room, the item will be there
Ring_ElevatedRing: Found in the Forlorn Coast location on Losomn. On the other side of the broken bridge that starts from the Mournful Promenade Worldstone, access the lift to go down, the item will be at the bottom of the ride
Ring_DowngradedRing: Found in the first overworld location on N'Erud. Awarded by the Custodian after you defeat the Sha'Hala world boss. Do not use the Override Pin on the terminal before the fight
Ring_EncryptedLoop: Found in The Labyrinth location, starting from Fractured Ingress go down the stairs and follow the wall on the left
Ring_EndairasEndlessLoop: Found in the Endaira's End location on Yaesha. Near the checkpoint at the end of the location
Ring_ExcessCoil: Found in an indoor location on N'erud. You need to lure the W.D 109 aberration that you will fight in the area near the door behind which the item is, or it will stay closed forever
Ring_FaeProtectorSignet: Found in the Council Chamber location on Losomn. Talk to the Council and agree to find out the traitor. Complete the level and transition to the Council Tribunal location by interacting with the mirror at the end of the location. There, proceed until you reach council seats and interact with them to obtain the council key quest items. Put the keys back into the seats in the correct order from left to right: teal, red and purple. This will open the throne room, go there and climb on the ledge behind the throne, and jump to the back of the throne from there. Pick up the Assassin Dagger quest item, and inspect it, noticing the colour of the jewel on it. Return to the Council Chamber and when asked to accuse, accuse the wrong person. The right person corresponds to the Dagger jewel colour: teal - Savan, red - Oniril, purple - Nyele. The item will be given as the reward for defeating the three council members afterwards
Ring_FaelinsSigil: Found in the Beatific Gallery location on Losomn, given by Faelin as a reward for killing Faerin, a world boss in the Malefic Gallery location on Losomn
Ring_FaerinsSigil: Found in the Malefic Gallery location on Losomn, given by Faerin as a reward for killing Faelin, a world boss in the Beatific Gallery location on Losomn
Ring_FeastmastersSignet: You need to find the Ravenous Medallion in the Great Hall location and open the door to the Feast room. There will be a chimney with fire there. Crouch through it and at the other side you will find the item
Ring_FeatheryBinding: Obtained from Walt in Ancient Canopy or Luminous Vale location on Yaesha. Walt stands near different murals in these two areas depending on your quest progression. Exhaust all dialogs with Walt before finally dealing with Lydusa. Do not talk to Walt after obtaining Cherished Fracture. Return to Walt after Lydusa has been dealt with and talk to him one last time
Ring_FloodlitDiamond: Found in Proving Grounds location on Yaesha. After the second checkpoint, in the large, roughly square room with the 4 pot enemies on raised platforms in each corner, you need to go to the pressure plate in the left corner at the back of the room. This will lower the pillar across the room from you that you will see. On the nearest wall to this pillar near the ceiling there is an illusory wall that you need to jump through from the rising pillar. Go upstairs from there and find the item
Ring_FlyweightsSting: Can be found in the Corrupted Harbor location on Root Earth. After unlocking the door near the first checkpoint, go up the staircase and check the open shipping container on the left underneath the next flight of stairs
Ring_FocusedJewel: Found in an indoor location on N'Erud. There will be an area accessible via a wrecked train guarded by robots. At the end of it there will be a small drop where you find the item. Taking it activates an unkillable purple sphere that slowly chases you down and kills you
Ring_ForceMultiplier: Get from Spark at Ward 13 in exchange for the Decorum Cipher quest item, after completing Spark's Dark Horizon quest line.
